## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Carts are saved for logged-out users for 30 days (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Orders endpoint now returns prices in cents (#214)

### Fixed
- Checkout total now applies the discount code on mobile (#213)
- Search box keeps focus after typing the first letter (#215)

### Security
- Password reset links now expire (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF (#301)
- Invite teammates by email (#304)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Remove the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint (#305)
- Search results load about twice as fast on large catalogues (#308)

### Fixed
- Incorrect VAT rounding on invoice totals ending in .5 (#303)
- Date picker showing the wrong month in Safari (#307)

### Security
- Uploaded files could be read by other accounts (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command checks your setup (#42)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Config file renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml` (#41)

### Fixed
- The `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings (#40)
- Crash on Windows paths containing spaces (#45)

### Security
- Fix remote code execution via the YAML parser (CVE-2026-4411) (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires (#519)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Trips endpoint paginates by default, 50 per page (#518)

### Fixed
- Edits made offline were lost after login (#517)
- Map pins overlapped on small screens (#521)

### Security
- Shared links exposed the owner's email address (#522)

### Removed
- Legacy trip importer (#524)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Internet Explorer 11 is no longer supported (#93)

### Fixed
- Undo skipping every second change in the editor (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel keep their borders (#94)

### Security
- Session tokens are no longer written to the browser console (#90)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Added
- Pause a subscription for up to 3 months (#706)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Fixed
- Receipts showed the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- CSV exports no longer cut off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Security
- Webhook signatures are now verified, so forged webhooks are rejected (#705)
